context.goal: Prevent simulation loop from stopping on remaining solver-level structural/numeric errors

symptoms: Simulation could still stop on 'Singular matrix!', 'Matrix error', 'wire loop detected', or FindPathInfo structural checks
If stamping failed (preStamp/stamp), the simulation loop could continue into runCircuit and crash/stop via exceptions
root_cause: Some solver/validation paths still used stop() for structural singularities and internal wire-current dependency loops
CircuitDocument update loop always called runCircuit() even if stamping did not complete

changes.summary: Add non-fatal warningMessage/warn(); treat Matrix error and linear singular matrix as warn+retry in recovery mode; handle wire loop detected by approximating wire currents; make preStampAndStampCircuit() return boolean success
In recovery mode, convert structural checks (voltage-source loop, rail-to-ground no-resistance) from stop() into warn() + enable singular stabilizers
Skip runCircuit() when preStampAndStampCircuit() returns false to avoid exceptions and keep loop alive
Update stepSimulation() to respect boolean stamp result and avoid stepping when stamp incomplete
Render warningMessage under Mode when no fatal stopMessage is present

tradeoffs: Some structurally invalid circuits now continue with stabilization rather than stopping; waveforms may be non-physical
Wire current calculation in cyclic wire loops is approximated to preserve responsiveness
